front.text: Issues are known. Conversations are delayed. Standards are bending. What you don’t say is becoming the rule.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF expectations keep needing to be reset
IF commitments are missed and not addressed repeatedly
IF you keep having to step in to do the work

back.text: What you allow becomes the standard.

front.text: People stop speaking up. Ideas disappear. Engagement fades. Silence is a response, not a lack of ideas.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF someone stays quiet even when invited to contribute
IF ideas stop showing up across the team
IF silence started after tension or disagreement
back.text: THEN choose a CONFLICT RESOLUTION Card.

front.text: Agreement in meetings. Resistance after. Momentum disappears. Agreement isn’t commitment.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF decisions were discussed but never truly owned
IF the “why” behind the decision isn’t clear
IF one person keeps undermining the decision after the meeting

back.text: Unaddressed passive resistance grows into active resistance.

front.text: Results are slipping. Deadlines are missed. Quality is inconsistent. Pushing harder hasn’t fixed this.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF the work is getting done, but the results aren’t improving
IF standards are clear, but performance is still below them
IF they're trying, but progress feels stalled or uneven
back.text: THEN choose a MOTIVATION & STRENGTHS Card.
Low performance requires diagnosis, not pressure.

front.text: Energy is fading. Engagement is dropping. Care is disappearing. Pushing harder might make this worse.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF motivation has shifted or energy feels flat
back.text: THEN choose a MOTIVATION & STRENGTHS Card.

back.heading: IF the work no longer feels meaningful
IF workload no longer matches capacity or priorities

back.text: Burnout is a signal, not a flaw.

front.text: “What’s next?” keeps coming up. Motivation is wavering. The path is unclear. They don’t know what this is leading to.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF they don't feel challenged
IF effort is there, but energy isn’t
back.text: THEN choose a MOTIVATION & STRENGTHS Card.

back.heading: IF what success looks like next is unclear

front.text: Results are strong. Behavior is costly. Others are frustrated. The results are masking a real issue.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF results are strong but behavior is hurting the team
IF standards feel unfair because high performers get a pass
IF growth has stalled despite high output

front.text: Tone is negative. Energy feels off. Others are impacted. This tone and behavior is affecting more than you think.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF standards were never clarified
IF behavior violates expectations
IF negativity increased after a change

back.text: Behavior shapes culture faster than words.

front.text: Tasks get done. Initiative is missing. Everything comes back to you. You've been stepping in and now they’re waiting for you.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF people wait to be told what to do
IF initiative drops once tasks are assigned
back.text: THEN choose a MOTIVATION & STRENGTHS Card.

back.heading: IF ownership was never defined

back.text: Managers teach tasks, Leaders invite ownership.

front.text: Work overlaps. Things fall through. Tension is building. No one’s sure who owns what, and it shows.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF expectations were assumed instead of defined
IF the role doesn’t fit someone’s strengths
back.text: THEN choose a MOTIVATION & STRENGTHS Card.

back.heading: IF boundaries keep getting crossed or blurred

front.text: Tensions are high. Collaboration is fading. The issue isn’t resolving. If you don’t step in, the team will keep picking sides.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF misunderstanding exists
back.text: THEN choose a CONFLICT RESOLUTION Card.

back.heading: IF behavior violates team values
IF one person is driving it

back.text: When handled properly, conflict creates opportunity for growth.

front.text: Standards are slipping. Behaviors are tolerated. Trust is eroding. What you let slide is now becoming the culture.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF values weren't clearly established or reinforced
IF behavior keeps crossing the line
IF a recent change has shifted norms

back.text: Culture drifts when leaders stay silent.

front.text: Pushback is growing. Energy is draining. Uncertainty is high. Resistance is often information, not defiance.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF the reason for the change isn’t clear
IF people don’t see how they win after the change
IF resistance shows up in behavior

back.text: Resistance is a sign to dig deeper.

front.text: Discussions repeat. Ownership is unclear. Nothing moves forward. Discussion is happening, decisions aren't.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF the decision isn’t defined
IF buy-in or commitment is missing after a decision
IF execution lacks ownership

front.text: Progress has stalled. Ownership is unclear. Frustration is rising. The plan didn’t fall apart, the handoffs did.
Pause before reacting.

back.heading: IF roles or priorities are unclear
IF project decisions are stuck
IF commitments aren’t met

back.text: Most project failures are conversation failures.
